summary: Iter 6 (Admin Full Control toolset — user search / ban / unban / CSV export) tested. Backend pytest: 49/49 PASSED (39 prior + 10 new TestAdminUserControl). Frontend smoke verified: 5 admin tabs (tab-pending/tab-users/tab-keys/tab-logs/tab-board), Users panel renders user-search-input + filter-status + filter-gate + search-btn + export-csv-btn + users-list, search 'admin' returned 3 rows, status=active filter returned 42 rows with 39 Ban buttons (admin row correctly omits Ban), CSV button visible. Ban/unban full lifecycle (login 403 '차단된 계정입니다.', /posts 403, unban → re-login OK) confirmed via API tests.

minor.issue: Default sort is created_at desc + limit 50; with current ~85+ user dataset, the auto-seeded admin (oldest row) is pushed off the first page. Consumers must paginate or use q=admin to surface admin in listings.
Does not include uid/id column — recommend adding 'id' as first column so external tools can correlate back to ban/unban API.

issues: Visible tab label uses 'INITIATION (53)' instead of 'PENDING' — cosmetic copy mismatch with admin-pending semantic; data-testid=tab-pending is correct.

Status filter dropdown defaults to 'ACTIVE' instead of empty (all). New admin opening the tab will not see pending/banned/rejected users until they manually clear the filter — moderate UX issue. Recommend default empty/'All Statuses'.

action_items: (Optional) Add 'id' column as first column in /admin/users/export.csv for round-trip correlation.
(Optional) Default Admin Users-tab status filter to empty/'All Statuses' so admins see pending+banned by default.
(Cosmetic) Rename visible tab label from 'INITIATION' to 'PENDING' to match endpoint and product spec; or update spec.
Carry forward iter5 items: gate logger.info OTP-resend (server.py:411) and password-reset (server.py:454) behind DEV_MODE; split server.py (now 1341 lines) into routers; CSS uppercase on nav-pillars.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1341 lines (was 1210 in iter5, 87% over 700-line guideline). Router split is overdue and was explicitly deferred per agent_to_agent_context_note.
admin_user_search performs N+1 queries (count_documents per user for posts_count and invites_count). For >200 users this is slow; consider $facet aggregation or denormalised counters.

admin_export_csv uses StringIO and returns the entire CSV as a single chunk via iter([output.getvalue()]) — for 10k+ users this buffers ~MBs in memory. For now (current dataset ~85), fine; revisit if user count grows.

Banned user with pre-existing valid JWT cookie will be force-logged-out on next /posts call (require_active 403), but /auth/me still returns 200 with status=banned. Frontend should listen for status=banned in /auth/me and trigger client-side logout to avoid stale UX.
ban_reason in admin_unban is $unset, but original ban audit trail is now lost. Consider keeping a ban_history array for audit retention.

success_rate.backend: 100% (49/49 pytest, including all 4 rate-limit tests + 10 new iter6 tests)
success_rate.frontend: Smoke 100% — all data-testids on Users tab present and functional; ban/unban inline buttons render correctly with admin row excluded from Ban.
